description:
## What changed

A new patch, Keep the Favorites tab, on by default. Two people found the Favorites tab on their profile empty after patching: the tab was there, the saved videos were not. TikTok's server can put an account into an experiment that skips building that tab's pages, and forcing either of the two gates behind it on a test phone produced the reporters' page exactly. The patch answers those two reads with the values that keep the tab, and the diagnostic report says when it did. The switch is under Settings, Interface. If your tab is still empty on this build, the report now carries what's needed to see why: see below.

EDIT: The favorites tab is still broken, checking now...

A second new patch, Comment publish diagnostics, on by default. On a Galaxy S25 running the released 0.33.0, tapping Send on a comment left the text in the box with no toast and nothing in the log, on every video tried, with the settings at their defaults too. TikTok's publish code has a dozen ways to return before the request without a word, and nothing in the bundle touches that path. So the report now says whether the send reached that code, what it had in hand (the text's length, the attachments, a reply target, the video), and whether it returned early or handed the comment to the request. The next export from that phone will name the exit.

Reposting a video no longer arms the send confirmation. With Confirm before sending on, tapping Repost used to show "tap again to send" and only act on a second tap, because the confirmation gate treated every share-sheet button as a person to send to. It now gates only the recipients.

The diagnostic report grew three sections' worth of answers. A Feature Gate Lab section says whether overrides are on, lists each rule with its value, and says for each one whether TikTok has read that gate since the app started, from where, and what TikTok had before the override. The feed filter table counts a profile list or a late insertion that arrived empty, says when a route was handed something that is not a video, and gives the profile video pager's ad event a line of its own instead of sharing the grid's. With diagnostic logging on, the profile routes list every video they kept with its ad markers, so a report about an ad that got through a profile page carries the ad itself and not only the counts. And playback quality now reports the gear it picked and every gear it chose from, for the phones where both model strings come back empty and the gear list is the only path left.

AMOLED dark theme reaches the comments sheet and the share sheet now. Both are painted from theme style values that never went through the colour table the patch rewrote, which is why they stayed TikTok's grey with the patch on. On a TikTok build the patch is forced onto, a sheet style name that build does not have is skipped instead of failing the whole patch.

The "Blocked" banner with Undo sits above TikTok's tab bar on the feed and above the input row in the comments sheet, on the same scrim, hairline and corner radius as the chips beside it. It used to be pinned a fixed distance up from the bottom of whichever screen it was on, over the tabs on one phone and on top of the comment box in the sheet.

Settings got a round of fixes. Search settings opens with the box focused, the keyboard up and a Search key on it, and autocorrect off in that box. A dialog that refuses a value moves the focus to the field and reads the reason out. The SIM country preset list marks the preset already chosen, opens scrolled to it, and has Clear preset beside Cancel. A row greyed out by another switch says which switch would turn it on, a greyed switch shows whether it is on, and the two Region rows that only said in prose that they need Override SIM details are now wired to it. While a backup, restore, reset or undo runs, the four Diagnostics rows go out of reach and the acting one says what it is doing.

In the Feature Gate Lab, editing a structured gate's fields shows that a save is pending, offers Discard edits, and says so if you leave with edits unsaved. When overrides are off, the detail page says so above the controls with a Turn on overrides action, instead of a grey caption after the last row.

## Validation

1,356 runtime tests and 203 patch tests passed locally with no failures, errors or skips, and both Android API level checks passed. The bundle carries 81 patches with all three DEX payloads non-empty, and every patch applied with zero failures to the 46.2.3, 46.7.3 and 46.8.3 fixtures; the receipt beside this release records each verdict. Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

On a Galaxy S22 running this build: with a Favorites gate forced through the Lab, the tab showed its two saved posts and the report named the refusal; playback quality on lowest picked the 540p gear of 720p and 540p, and on highest the 1080p gear of three; the comments sheet read pure black in dark mode; the Undo banner ended 49 pixels above the tab bar; Search opened focused with the keyboard up; both Region rows were greyed with the reason; the SIM preset dialog marked United States and offered Clear preset. Every dark style literal behind the comments and share sheets reads black in the patched APK, checked with aapt2, while the light ones are untouched.

On a Galaxy S25 patched with the released 0.33.0 through Morphe Manager, the empty Favorites tab reproduced on a real account. Nothing in this release is claimed to fix that phone yet: the Lab section and the empty-delivery counter are what its next report will carry.
